mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_rag_query_log (query_ref, question_hash, session_ref, retrieved_policy_ids, answer_quality_score, latency_ms, cache_hit, degraded) VALUES ( #{queryRef}, #{questionHash}, #{sessionRef}, #{retrievedPolicyIds}::jsonb'[]'::jsonb, #{answerQualityScore}, #{latencyMs}, #{cacheHit}, #{degraded} )
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_rag_query_log SET feedback = #{feedback}, feedback_at = now() WHERE query_ref = #{queryRef}
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) AS totalQueries, count(*) FILTER (WHERE feedback = 'HELPFUL') AS helpfulCount, count(*) FILTER (WHERE feedback IS NOT NULL) AS feedbackCount, count(*) FILTER (WHERE cache_hit = TRUE) AS cacheHitCount, count(*) FILTER (WHERE degraded = TRUE) AS degradedCount, COALESCE(sum(latency_ms), 0) AS latencySumMs FROM ai_rag_query_log WHERE queried_at >= COALESCE(#{from}::timestamptz, now() - INTERVAL '7 days') AND queried_at < COALESCE((#{to}::date + INTERVAL '1 day'), now() + INTERVAL '1 day')

SELECT (queried_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS day, count(*) AS queryCount, count(*) FILTER (WHERE feedback = 'HELPFUL') AS helpfulCount, count(*) FILTER (WHERE feedback IS NOT NULL) AS feedbackCount FROM ai_rag_query_log WHERE queried_at >= COALESCE(#{from}::timestamptz, now() - INTERVAL '7 days') AND queried_at < COALESCE((#{to}::date + INTERVAL '1 day'), now() + INTERVAL '1 day') GROUP BY (queried_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date ORDER BY day ASC
